notes.title: Patch 3.0.1
notes.content: [p]Thank you for your initial feedback following the release of version 3.0.0 of the National Assembly virtual tour.[/p][p]We are now rolling out a first patch (3.0.1) including the following adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the automatic removal of the interface at the end of cutscenes to prevent soft lock situations[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced music volume during cutscenes to improve narrator audibility[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed overly fast repetition of the gallery wall texture in the hemicycle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an incorrectly applied balustrade material in the Presidential aisle[/p][/*][/list][p]As part of our ongoing efforts to provide a smoother and more immersive experience, we will continue to enhance the virtual tour with further patches, optimizations, and improvements.[/p]

notes.title: Update 3.0.0: Hôtel de Lassay Added & End of Early Access
notes.content: [h1]End of Early Access (version 3.0.0)[/h1][p]For the past two years, we’ve been working on improving the virtual tour of the French National Assembly based on your feedback.[/p][p]With the experience now complete, this major update officially marks the end of the Early Access phase on Steam.[/p][p]Content updates and bug fixes will continue to be released.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41196863/fe19991ed4574356a2b552ebdc323db0b0cf4e93.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41196863/fe52e462fd17b6330dfba2a6e4648a0328dd2e21.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]New: Visit the Hôtel de Lassay[/h1][p]In this major update, the Hôtel de Lassay (the President’s residence) is now part of the virtual tour of the French National Assembly.[/p][p]You can now explore 8 new rooms, each with its own atmosphere, history, and heritage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41196863/5bb59e10d7e88db9f760cc741937324f2b8a086e.png"][/img][/p][h1]Full List of New Features[/h1][p]With this major 3.0.0 update, here is the list of improvements and new content we’ve added:[/p][list][*][p]Addition of the Hôtel de Lassay, allowing you to explore 8 new rooms: the Cabinet du Départ, the Salon des Éléments, the Grand Salon, the Salon des Saisons, the Salon des Jeux, the Vestibule, the Dining Room, and the Salon des Stucs[/p][/*][*][p]Update of the Grand Rotunda with newly installed busts[/p][/*][*][p]Update of the Library to reflect its recent restoration[/p][/*][*][p]New option in the settings to enable more realistic global illumination (dynamic mode)[/p][/*][*][p]Complete overhaul of lighting and visual effects[/p][/*][*][p]Improved support for certain virtual reality headsets[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of new interactive points of interest[/p][/*][*][p]New media content (texts and images) added to points of interest[/p][/*][*][p]Complete redesign of user interfaces for a smoother experience[/p][/*][*][p]English translations added for interfaces and points of interest[/p][/*][*][p]Improved quality of many existing 3D objects, materials, and textures[/p][/*][*][p]Removal of camera sway for more comfortable movement[/p][/*][*][p]Improved interactive map in the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Updated "Sculptor" achievement to include the 2 new busts added with the Hôtel de Lassay[/p][/*][*][p]New graphical options added to the game settings[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: European Heritage Days 2022
notes.content:
On the occasion of the European Heritage Days, which will take place on September 17 and 18, 2022, we are rolling out a major update to the virtual visit of the Assemblée nationale.

[h1]Additions and improvements[/h1]
Below is the list of the main additions and improvements made by this update

[h2]New places to explore:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The "fronton de l'Assemblée nationale"
[*] The "Grande rotonde"
[*] The "rotonde d'Alechinsky"
[*] The "salle des Fêtes"
[*] The "galerie des Tapisseries"
[*] The "salle des Pas perdus"
[*] The "salle des Quatre-Colonnes"
[*] The "jardin des Quatre-Colonnes"
[*] The "salle des Conférences"
[*] The "salon Zao Wou-Ki"
[/list]
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Multiplayer[/b]: Added group visits, allowing you to visit the Assemblée nationale with other visitors
[*] [b]Success[/b]: Added 8 achievements to unlock
[*] [b]Interactive map[/b]: Find your position on the map and quickly teleport from one room to another
[*] [b]Points of interest[/b]: Added new explanatory points of interest, especially in new rooms
[/list]
[h2]Content improvement:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Interfaces[/b]: Graphical overhaul of menus
[*][b]Controls[/b]: Better support for VR gamepads and controllers
[/list]
